claim: The Cognito FAQ describes the Amazon Cognito Sync store as a key/value pair store linked to an Amazon Cognito identity, with no limit to the number of identities in identity pools and the sync store. Amazon Cognito Sync is no longer open to new customers.
question: What is the Amazon Cognito Sync store, and can new customers still use it?

evidence.quote: The Amazon Cognito Sync store is a key/value pair store linked to an Amazon Cognito identity. There is no limit to the number of identities you can create in your identity pools and sync store.
Amazon Cognito Sync is no longer open to new customers.

note: Cognito Sync closed to new customers (fact cognito-change-sync-closed-to-new-customers-2026-07, after the 2026-07-15 cutoff). Teach as legacy only.
